components.About.TeacherVoice.heading: Teachers already publishing their darasa here.
components.About.TeacherVoice.quote: I used to send lessons through group chats and lose half of them. On Darasaone my recordings, books and quizzes sit inside one course, and I can finally see which student understood the topic and which one needs me.
components.About.TeacherVoice.mediaAlt: Portrait of a Darasaone teacher in warm natural light
